title: Chmod Input
description: Stops permission mistakes that leak data or lock people out by reading any mode (644, 0755, u+x, -rwxr-xr-x) back as rwx and plain words, and flagging world-writable files, setuid and setgid, private keys and .env files others can read, a writable ~/.ssh or authorized_keys, execute bits on data files, 775 typed for 755, and short or decimal modes, each with a one-tap safe mode.
